Converting data into wide format from long format. 
```{r}
cytokines %>% select(-X) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cytokine, values_from = avg.res) ###???
```

```{r}
samplab.form <- samplabs %>%
  select(Subject.Number, placebo) %>%
  mutate(preP = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 1, 3), #quote bc exact string #==; is equal to operator #true = 1, false =3
         postP = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 2, 4), 
         preBRB = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 3, 1),
        postBRB = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 4, 2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "timepoint.label", values_to = "timepoints", cols = c("preP", "postP", "preBRB", "postBRB")) %>%
  mutate(Sample = paste0(Subject.Number, "-", timepoints)) %>%
  select(Sample, timepoint.label) 


cyto.form <- cytokines %>%
 select(-X) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cytokine, values_from = avg.res) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("^0", "", Sample), Sample = gsub("\\.1$", "", Sample)) %>%
  left_join(samplab.form) %>%
  mutate(berry.group = ifelse(grepl("postBRB",timepoint.label), 1, 0))
```

```{r}
object <- c("ALCAM.CD166", "C.Reactive.Protein.CRP", "CCL2.JE.MCP.1", "Complement.Component.C9", "Cystatin.C", "IL.1.beta.IL.1F2", "IL.10", "IL.12.IL.23.p40", "IL.6", "MMP.2", "S100A9", "TNF.alpha", "vWF.A2", "IL.17F")

capture.models.univ <- function(outcome, lfun, cytos, modin) {
  mods.list <- lapply(cytos, function(x)  try({glm(as.formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ ", x)), family = lfun, data = modin) %>% tidy()}))
  
mods.list.clean <- list.clean(mods.list, function(x) is.null(x))
mods.df <- bind_rows(mods.list.clean)
return(mods.df)
}
```


```{r warning=FALSE}
plot <- capture.models.univ(outcome = "berry.group", lfun = "binomial", cytos = object, modin = cyto.form) %>%
  filter(p.value<1.0) %>%
  filter(term !="(Intercept)") %>%
  # mutate(term = fct_reorder(term, estimate)) %>%
  mutate(pointlabs = ifelse(-log(p.value) > 0.5, term, NA)) %>%
  
ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = -log(p.value), label = pointlabs, color = term)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  labs(x = "Estimate", y = "-log(p-value)") 


```

```{r}
plot +
  geom_label_repel() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  # ggtitle("Effect Size of Cytokines in Current and Former Smokers") +
  # theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")

ggsave("../figures/cytokine_effect-size_volcano-plot.png")
```

#SJ
## mixed-effects model
```{r}
cyto_model_data <- cyto.form %>%
  filter(timepoint.label %in% c("preBRB", "postBRB")) %>%
  mutate(pt = sub("-.*", "", Sample))  # Extracts Subject.Number

run_mixed_model <- function(cytokine_name, data) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste0("berry.group ~ ", cytokine_name, " + (1 | pt)"))
  model <- glmer(formula, data = data, family = binomial)
  return(tidy(model))
}

# Apply to all cytokines
cyto_mixed_results_all <- lapply(object, function(cyt) {
  res <- tryCatch(run_mixed_model(cyt, cyto_model_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(res)) res$cytokine <- cyt
  return(res)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()


cyto_effects_all <- cyto_mixed_results_all %>%
  filter(!(term %in% c("(Intercept)", "sd__(Intercept)")))


```

```{r}
cyto_effects_all <- cyto_mixed_results_all %>%
  filter(!(term %in% c("(Intercept)", "sd__(Intercept)"))) %>%
  select(cytokine, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>%
  arrange(p.value)

```

```{r}
cyto_effects_all %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(-log10(p.value) > 0.5, cytokine, NA)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = -log10(p.value), label = label)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_label_repel() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Log-odds estimate (Effect Size)",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    title = "Volcano Plot of Cytokine Effects (Mixed Model)"
  )

```

```{r}
cyto_effects_all %>%
  mutate(label = cytokine) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = -log10(p.value), label = label)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = estimate)) +
  geom_label_repel() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect Size (estimate)",
    y = "-log10(p-value)")


```

```{r}
cyto_model_data <- cyto.form %>%
  filter(timepoint.label %in% c("preBRB", "postBRB")) %>%
  mutate(pt = sub("-.*", "", Sample),
         pt = as.factor(pt))  # Ensure pt is a factor


compliance_cluster_df <- as.data.frame(compliance_cluster_df)
compliance_cluster_df$pt <- rownames(compliance_cluster_df)

# Get responder IDs
responder_ids <- rownames(compliance_cluster_df[compliance_cluster_df$BRB_response == "Responder", ])

# Subset modeling data to responders only
cyto_model_data_responder <- cyto_model_data %>%
  filter(pt %in% responder_ids)

# Apply mixed model to responder subset
cyto_mixed_results_responders <- lapply(object, function(cyt) {
  run_mixed_model(cyt, cyto_model_data_responder)
}) %>% bind_rows(.id = "cytokine_index")


```

```{r}
cyto_effects_responders <- cyto_mixed_results_responders %>%
  filter(!(term %in% c("(Intercept)", "sd__(Intercept)"))) %>%
  rename(cytokine = term) %>%
  select(cytokine, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>%
  arrange(p.value)

ggplot(cyto_effects_responders, aes(x = estimate, y = -log10(p.value), label = cytokine)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_label_repel(data = subset(cyto_effects_responders, -log10(p.value) > 0.5)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect Size (estimate)",
    y = "-log10(p-value)")

```
